ordering: MEDIUM/MEDIUM_HARD/HARD/VERY_HARD round robin, within stratum SHA256(seed|canonical_url|question_hash)
exclude: all1000 original TACO test identities conservatively; available LCB and project task identities; near duplicate Jaccard>=.85; exact/AST reference overlap; interactive/image/ambiguous output; malformed cases

cases: 12 online developer tests +12 final tests by frozen hash after input dedup; statement samples excluded; all from official benchmark, not newly claimed statement examples

reference_distinctness: different normalized AST; no claim independent algorithms
negative: constant impossible sentinel must fail all tests
